title: Quantum Natural Gradient on Quotient Spaces
summary: A parametrized quantum circuit reports its state geometry through a quantum Fisher information matrix (QFIM), often singular. A small Fisher value can reflect exact state-preserving redundancy, compression by the circuit chart, or weak intrinsic distinguishability, and these mechanisms call for different numerical treatments. We show that the circuit metric factors as $F=B^{*}MB$, where $B$ is the state-level circuit-to-orbit differential and $M$ is the intrinsic Fisher operator on the reachable orbit.
